AI4BT Global Summit concludes with focus on enterprise AI transformation

The three-day virtual AI4BT Global Summit 2026 concluded on Sunday (27 September), bringing together global and Bangladeshi experts to discuss AI-driven enterprise transformation, organisational readiness, executive training, the future of Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), and cybersecurity.
